also_today: U.S. loses its measles-free status after 26 years — 5,400+ cases, 10 deaths.
Category 5 Cyclone Xavier strikes the Northern Cook Islands.
Magnitude 6.0 earthquake hits Papua New Guinea; 5.3 tremor in Romania.
note: Real world news of 18 November 2026, verified 18 Nov 2026 against Just Security Early Edition, One Turn, Horizon, NPR News Now 3am ET bulletin, and Daily Baku. Embedded in the entry so the program needs no network at grade time.

stories.headline: U.S. strikes Iran; Tehran hits back at Gulf bases
stories.summary: U.S. jets hit a Guard missile site on Qeshm Island; Iran hit back with drones at U.S. bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

stories.headline: Crimea Bridge partly collapses after Ukrainian strike
stories.summary: Ukraine struck the Kerch Bridge for a second day; part of its road span fell into the strait below.

stories.headline: Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen ahead of Trump summit
stories.summary: China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin opened talks a day before a trilateral summit with President Trump.

stories.headline: Democrats take the U.S. Senate in Alaska upset
stories.summary: Mary Peltola defeated Sen. Dan Sullivan, giving Democrats a 56-44 majority in the incoming Senate.

stories.headline: Russian military plane crashes in Siberia; 19 dead
stories.summary: A military aircraft went down in the Kemerovo region, killing all 19 people on board.

stories.headline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo more than doubles
stories.summary: Cases passed 11,000 with 5,400 deaths, the UN said. Children under five are suffering the worst toll.
